items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed income is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Minimum measurement: period-aligned attributable revenue and tracking IDs, reconciled AI/infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs, approved budget limits, experiment costs, and explicit learning outcomes. Continue only existing reconciliation and containment work.

Retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only. Impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, and AI usage are operating signals, not financial returns. Do not create or requeue production work, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, or monetization changes this cycle.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Preserve the 2026-09-21 $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed and retain unknown margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift. Keep the private launch gate unchanged; no rights-dependent monetization or external outreach is financially supported.
